brief_answer: To track protein concentration in a whey stream that shifts from clear to turbid, start by testing NIR transflection, which can handle varying dairy liquid conditions. If extreme turbidity causes light blockage, an MIR ATR probe serves as a robust alternative since it samples via surface evanescent waves. Laboratory reference assays should be used to build and validate chemometric calibration models.
